name: security-account-identifier-reuse-review
intent: Reassigned account identifiers inheriting a previous principal authority
artifacts: Account creation/deletion schema, immutable principal IDs, username/email/numeric-ID reuse rules, ACL joins, group memberships and entitlement caches.
trace: Trace a genuinely new principal through identifier allocation into old ACLs, memberships or ownership. Distinguish stable principal identity from a recycled display or login identifier; route residual deleted-record access to security-deleted-data-access-review.
experiment: In a disposable identity fixture grant principal P1 a marker capability, retire P1, assign its reusable login label to distinct P2 and compare P2 with a fresh control and an explicitly restored P1.
disproof: An authorized restoration of the same principal or harmless display-name reuse is not cross-principal authority transfer; require an inherited protected capability under the product identity policy.
repair: Bind grants to immutable principals or identity generations, retire stale memberships/caches and verify safe identifier reuse alongside intended same-principal restoration.
branch_decisions: Distinguish an intentionally restored account from a genuinely new principal assigned a reused name, email or numeric ID. Follow immutable principal identity into ACLs, group memberships, ownership and cached entitlements. A recycled display name is harmless unless it selects old authority; compare a new principal with a legitimate restoration under the declared lifecycle policy.
